name: Meltlilith
source:
Meltlilith is a High-Servant of BB in Fate/Extra CCC.

[spoiler]Meltlilith was created by BB as a Heroic Spirit-Complex. Classified as a High-Servant who is composed of three goddesses, Artemis, Lotan, and Saraswati.[/spoiler]
